title: Export selected dynamic sales-order report page to Excel
description: User scene: download exactly the selected, authorized sales-order report page and optional grouped page totals as xlsx. Reuse ERP-112 query/scope and ERP.Infrastructure.Export.ExcelExporter; revalidate fields, filters, page cap and current ERP permission on export, and escape spreadsheet formula-leading text. Fail closed on auth/validation/query error and preserve existing request audit. Development-only read-only export: no arbitrary SQL, database writes, migration, real database execution, secret/.env change, or deployment. Verify with xlsx unit tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated Excel endpoint reuses the bounded scoped preview and selected field order, rechecks current-user permission and rejects invalid or out-of-scope requests.
Export uses existing ExcelExporter for only the current page and optional currency-separated page subtotals; text beginning with spreadsheet formula characters stays literal.
Designer downloads the selected report and handles empty/authorization failures; tests inspect workbook columns, rows, formula safety, grouping and scope; document export limits.
